claude-cowork-2026-09:WN11-UR-000060.caution: Developer tooling that creates symlinks under a standard account will stop working.

claude-cowork-2026-09:WN11-UR-000070.summary: Set the Deny access to this computer from the network right so the Guests group is always denied, and on domain systems also deny Enterprise Admins, Domain Admins, and the Local account group. This keeps stolen high-privilege or local credentials from being used to reach the workstation remotely. PAWs dedicated to AD management are exempt from denying the admin groups.
claude-cowork-2026-09:WN11-UR-000070.caution: Denying Local account blocks remote use of every local account, including any local admin used for support; plan an alternative before applying.

claude-cowork-2026-09:WN11-UR-000075.summary: On domain-joined workstations, add the Enterprise Admins and Domain Admins groups to Deny log on as a batch job so those powerful accounts cannot run scheduled tasks on lower-trust machines. Standalone systems are exempt.
claude-cowork-2026-09:WN11-UR-000075.caution: Scheduled tasks configured to run as a domain admin account will stop running.

claude-cowork-2026-09:WN11-UR-000080.summary: On domain-joined workstations, add the Enterprise Admins and Domain Admins groups to Deny log on as a service so those accounts cannot be used to run services on lower-trust machines. Standalone systems are exempt.
claude-cowork-2026-09:WN11-UR-000080.caution: The rule itself warns that incorrect configuration can prevent services from starting; confirm no service runs under a domain admin account first.

claude-cowork-2026-09:WN11-UR-000085.summary: Set Deny log on locally so the Guests group is always denied, and on domain systems also deny Enterprise Admins and Domain Admins, so high-privilege domain accounts are never used interactively on ordinary workstations. PAWs dedicated to AD management are exempt from denying the admin groups.
claude-cowork-2026-09:WN11-UR-000085.caution: Administrators who habitually sign in to workstations with domain admin accounts will be locked out of that practice.

claude-cowork-2026-09:WN11-UR-000090.summary: Set Deny log on through Remote Desktop Services so Guests are always denied, and on domain systems also deny Enterprise Admins, Domain Admins, and the Local account group. If Remote Desktop is not used at all, denying Everyone is acceptable instead. PAWs dedicated to AD management are exempt from denying the admin groups.
claude-cowork-2026-09:WN11-UR-000090.caution: Denying Everyone or Local account will cut off remote desktop support that relies on those accounts.

claude-cowork-2026-09:WN11-UR-000095.summary: Make sure no group or account holds the Enable computer and user accounts to be trusted for delegation user right; the policy should be defined but blank. The right allows changing delegation settings, which could let someone impersonate other users.

claude-cowork-2026-09:WN11-UR-000100.summary: Limit the Force shutdown from a remote system user right to the Administrators group, so nobody else can remotely shut the machine down and cause an outage.

claude-cowork-2026-09:WN11-UR-000110.summary: Limit the Impersonate a client after authentication user right to Administrators, LOCAL SERVICE, NETWORK SERVICE, SERVICE, and RESTRICTED SERVICES\PrintSpoolerService. The right lets a program act as another user and could be used to escalate privileges.
claude-cowork-2026-09:WN11-UR-000110.caution: Server-style applications (web or database services) running under custom accounts may need this right and will break if it is removed.

claude-cowork-2026-09:WN11-UR-000120.summary: Limit the Load and unload device drivers user right to the Administrators group, since loading a driver is an easy way to run malicious code in the kernel.

claude-cowork-2026-09:WN11-UR-000125.summary: Make sure no group or account holds the Lock pages in memory user right; the policy should be defined but blank. The right lets a process pin physical memory, which can starve the system and cause a denial of service.
claude-cowork-2026-09:WN11-UR-000125.caution: Some database software asks for this right for its service account; removing it may reduce that software's performance.

claude-cowork-2026-09:WN11-UR-000130.summary: Limit the Manage auditing and security log user right to Administrators (an organizational Auditors group is also acceptable). Anyone with it can clear the security log or change audit settings and erase evidence of tampering.

claude-cowork-2026-09:WN11-UR-000140.summary: Limit the Modify firmware environment values user right to the Administrators group, since changing firmware variables can cause hardware failures or prevent the system from booting.

claude-cowork-2026-09:WN11-UR-000145.summary: Limit the Perform volume maintenance tasks user right to the Administrators group, because it allows managing or deleting disk volumes and could cause data loss.
claude-cowork-2026-09:WN11-UR-000145.caution: Database software that uses instant file initialization under a service account will lose that capability.

claude-cowork-2026-09:WN11-UR-000150.summary: Limit the Profile single process user right to the Administrators group, so ordinary users cannot monitor the performance of other processes to identify targets for attack.

claude-cowork-2026-09:WN11-UR-000160.summary: Limit the Restore files and directories user right to the Administrators group, since it bypasses file permissions and could be used to overwrite current data.
claude-cowork-2026-09:WN11-UR-000160.caution: Backup or restore software running under a dedicated non-admin account will need that account added or reworked.

claude-cowork-2026-09:WN11-UR-000165.summary: Limit the Take ownership of files or other objects user right to the Administrators group, since taking ownership lets a user change permissions on anything and then modify it.

claude-cowork-2026-09:WN11-00-000065.summary: Review local accounts and disable or delete any enabled account that has not logged on in the past 35 days, excluding the built-in Administrator, Guest, DefaultAccount, and the local administrator account. The rule gives a PowerShell script that lists each account's last logon. Inactive accounts that are still needed must be documented with the ISSO.
claude-cowork-2026-09:WN11-00-000065.caution: Disabling an account that a service or rarely used process depends on will break it; confirm before disabling.

claude-cowork-2026-09:WN11-00-000085.summary: On a domain-joined workstation, the only local accounts should be the built-in ones (Administrator, Guest, DefaultAccount, defaultuser0, WDAGUtilityAccount) and local administrator accounts. Remove any other local user accounts; people should sign in with domain accounts. Standalone systems are exempt.
claude-cowork-2026-09:WN11-00-000085.caution: Deleting a local account removes its profile and data; confirm the account is not in use first.

claude-cowork-2026-09:WN11-00-000260.summary: Make sure the Windows time service syncs with an authorized DoD time source. Domain-joined systems should show NT5DS (time from the domain) in the W32tm configuration output; systems that use an NTP server must point it at an authorized server through the Windows NTP Client policy.
claude-cowork-2026-09:WN11-00-000260.caution: Pointing at an unreachable or wrong time server causes clock drift, which breaks Kerberos authentication and log correlation.

claude-cowork-2026-09:WN11-CC-000030.summary: Stop ICMP redirect messages from overriding the routing table, so an attacker on the network cannot redirect this machine's traffic. The policy requires the MSS-Legacy templates from the STIG package.
claude-cowork-2026-09:WN11-CC-000030.caution: The setting only appears in Group Policy after the MSS-Legacy templates are installed.

claude-cowork-2026-09:WN11-CC-000035.summary: Make the machine ignore NetBIOS name release requests unless they come from a WINS server, preventing a denial-of-service trick that floods the machine with name release requests. The policy requires the MSS-Legacy templates.
claude-cowork-2026-09:WN11-CC-000035.caution: The setting only appears in Group Policy after the MSS-Legacy templates are installed.

claude-cowork-2026-09:WN11-CC-000170.summary: Enable Allow Microsoft accounts to be optional so modern (Store-style) apps that support it can use enterprise credentials instead of requiring a personal Microsoft account.

claude-cowork-2026-09:WN11-CC-000175.summary: Turn off the Application Compatibility Inventory Collector so the machine does not gather data about installed programs and send it to Microsoft.

claude-cowork-2026-09:WN11-CC-000206.summary: Set Delivery Optimization Download Mode to anything except Internet, so Windows Update never exchanges update content with random PCs on the internet. LAN, Group, HTTP only, Simple, and Bypass are all acceptable; standalone systems are checked through a different registry value.
claude-cowork-2026-09:WN11-CC-000206.caution: Choosing HTTP only or Bypass on a large network removes peer caching and increases bandwidth to Microsoft.

claude-cowork-2026-09:WN11-CC-000220.summary: Keep File Explorer's heap termination on corruption enabled (the default), so a corrupted Explorer session is terminated rather than allowed to keep running with legacy plug-ins. Only an explicit policy turning it off is a finding; set it to Not Configured or Disabled.

claude-cowork-2026-09:WN11-CC-000390.summary: Stop Windows spotlight from suggesting third-party apps and content to users. This is a per-user policy under User Configuration, so it must be applied to user accounts rather than the computer.

claude-cowork-2026-09:WN11-SO-000050.summary: Do not disable automatic machine account password changes; the computer must keep rotating its own domain password. The policy Disable machine account password changes must be set to Disabled.
claude-cowork-2026-09:WN11-SO-000050.caution: Environments that clone or snapshot domain-joined machines sometimes disable this to avoid trust breakage; re-enabling it may surface those cases.

claude-cowork-2026-09:WN11-SO-000055.summary: Keep the maximum machine account password age at 30 days or less (never 0), which is the default, so the computer's domain password rotates monthly.

claude-cowork-2026-09:WN11-SO-000080.summary: Set the logon message title to DoD Notice and Consent Banner, US Department of Defense Warning Statement, or a site-defined equivalent that does not alter the meaning of the required banner text.
claude-cowork-2026-09:WN11-SO-000080.caution: A custom title must not contradict or soften the banner text required by the related rule.

claude-cowork-2026-09:WN11-SO-000085.summary: Limit cached domain logon credentials to 10 or fewer, which is the default. Cached credentials let users sign in when the domain is unreachable, but each one is a hash an attacker could try to crack. Only relevant on domain-joined systems.
claude-cowork-2026-09:WN11-SO-000085.caution: Setting it too low can prevent users from signing in to a laptop while off the network.

claude-cowork-2026-09:WN11-SO-000240.summary: Strengthen the default permissions on global system objects such as device names, mutexes, and semaphores, so non-admin users can read shared objects but not modify ones they did not create.

claude-cowork-2026-09:WN11-UC-000015.summary: Turn off toast notifications on the lock screen so message previews and other sensitive content are not shown to anyone who walks by. This is a per-user policy under User Configuration.
